lines.t: Voices rise in the halls of men,
Preaching rules built by their hands.
Words of truth turned inside out,
Lost in pride and holy sounds.
They speak of light but dim the flame,
Traditions old still bear the name.
But wisdom cries from heaven’s door,
Seek the truth and nothing more.
Beware of the doctrines of men,
Don’t stumble on the letter.
Let the Spirit guide you through,
Rightly divide the Word of Truth.
The parchments twist beneath the pen,
Translations bent by hearts of men.
But grace remains, it calls your name,
Through every shadow, every chain.
Lift your eyes and look above,
Study deep in His perfect love.
A workman stands, unashamed and new,
Walking strong in the light of Truth.
Beware of the doctrines of men,
Don’t stumble on the letter.
Let the Spirit guide you through,
Rightly divide the Word of Truth.
Not by power, not by might,
But by the Spirit’s holy light.
Break the chains of worldly view,
The living Word will see you through.
Beware of the doctrines of men,
Hold fast to the truth within.
Stand firm, your heart made new,
Rightly divide the Word of Truth.
